summary: First iteration end-to-end test of e.GHANA Visa Portal. 38/38 backend pytest cases pass (100%) when executed serially. Full frontend E2E: Home → Apply (form + 4 uploads + summary + visa sample) → Payment sandbox banner + modal → Success → Track → FAQ (8 items) → Admin login → Dashboard KPIs + status transitions (in_progress → done) → Ama chat with Claude Sonnet 4.5 all functional. One environmental UX issue: the Emergent preview badge overlaps the Ama floating chat button (bottom-right) intercepting pointer events.

minor.issue: Race in parallel tests: when TestAdminSettings.test_hubtel_config_update sets sandbox=false with test-only creds mid-flight, a concurrent test_payment_initiate_sandbox hits real Hubtel API and returns 500. Tests pass 100% under -n 0 serial execution. Not a product bug — a shared-settings test isolation issue. RECOMMEND: server-side, either (a) reject saving hubtel with sandbox=false unless credentials verify, or (b) wrap hubtel initiate_checkout with a try/except that falls back to a 400 instead of 500 when upstream fails.

ui_bugs.issue: Floating chat button (data-testid=ama-open) sits at fixed bottom-6/right-6 (z-50). The Emergent preview badge (a#emergent-badge) is rendered at the exact same corner and intercepts pointer events, blocking real user clicks on Ama. Programmatic clicks work; the underlying chat flow with Claude Sonnet 4.5 is 100% functional. Suggested fix: offset the Ama FAB (e.g., bottom-24 md:bottom-6) or raise its z-index above the badge (though Emergent badge may still layer above).

issues: Hydration warning in console: `<span> cannot be a child of <option>` — caused by Emergent instrumentation injecting spans inside <option>. Not a product bug; noise from preview environment.

action_items: Consider offsetting the Ama FAB position (e.g., bottom-24 right-6 on desktop) so the Emergent preview badge doesn't intercept its clicks in preview environments.
Optional: In hubtel_service.initiate_checkout, catch network errors and return HTTP 400 (or auto-fallback to sandbox) instead of surfacing 500 when live credentials are misconfigured.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 640 lines and holds all routes; consider splitting into modules (admin, public, payments) as the app grows.

storage_service.EmergentStorageBackend caches storage_key on the class instance but is a module-level singleton — a stale key on rotation would require restart. Consider TTL-based re-init or lazy retry on 401.

email_service.send always inserts to email_log with simulated=True initially, then flips to False on success — the log has both fields so this is fine, but if a resend send throws before the flag update, the entry stays simulated=True with error set (which is the intended behavior — good).
auth_utils.require_admin never checks that the admin actually still exists in DB (a deleted admin's token remains valid until expiry). Minor security hardening opportunity.
Payment confirm has no signature verification when Hubtel is live — the docstring notes this. In production this needs a Hubtel Status API call before flipping to paid.
Countries list is hard-coded — fine for a Ghana-only portal; acceptable.

success_rate.frontend: 100% functional; Ama FAB blocked by preview badge in emergentagent.com preview only

test_credentials: Admin: admin@eghanavisa.com / Admin@2026New! (rotated from default Admin@2026 during first-login test). Backend seeds default admin with must_change_password=true; the pytest fixture handles the initial rotation.
seed_data_creation: Backend startup seeds default admin, settings singleton, and 6 email templates (submitted/in_progress/done × en/fr). Tests inserted 3 paid applications visible in admin dashboard (2 marked done + 1 done via UI flow).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin password was rotated to Admin@2026New! during first-login flow. To re-run the full first-login flow from scratch, drop the admins collection or manually reset must_change_password. The pytest fixture already handles both paths (default and rotated).
rca of the issue: AMA FAB overlap: Emergent preview environment injects `a#emergent-badge` fixed at bottom-right — same corner as AmaChat FAB. Playwright reports 'emergent-badge intercepts pointer events'. Mitigation: move Ama FAB or programmatically click via JS in automation. In production (eghanavisa.com without Emergent badge), Ama is expected to work normally. PAYMENT INITIATE PARALLEL FAILURE: pytest-xdist runs class-level test scope, so TestAdminSettings and TestApplicationFlow run concurrently on different workers. When test_hubtel_config_update briefly sets sandbox=false with fake credentials, a concurrent payment initiate uses that live-mode config and hits the real Hubtel URL, returning 500. Under `pytest -n 0` all tests pass. This is a test-isolation issue for shared server state, not a product bug.
